About the author

Joel Burke

Technologist, Georgetown University alumnus, and author of Rebooting a Nation .
Joel Burke
joelburke2014@gmail.com @billyjoelburke in/joelburke1
Joel Burke is a technologist and Georgetown University alumnus based in Washington, D.C., with experience working on four continents, advising startups and governments alike.
Most notably, he led a team for the Republic of Estonia's e-Residency programme — the world's first transnational digital identity — helping to open a piece of Estonia's digital society to entrepreneurs around the globe. He has also advised members of the United States Congress on technology and artificial intelligence policy.
That vantage point — inside one of the world's most advanced digital states, and inside the halls where technology policy is written — is what makes Rebooting a Nation distinctive. It is at once a history, a technical explainer, and a candid account of the culture and decisions that let a nation of 1.3 million become a global leader in e-government and startups.

Speaking & media

Joel speaks and writes regularly on Estonia, digital government, state capacity, and technology policy, and is available for talks, panels, podcasts, and press. The best way to reach him is by email .
